items.problem: GetForCurrentView() replacement table only covers view/window singletons, so the agent had no recipe for feature-service singletons like AppCapture.GetForCurrentView() and left it throwing at runtime.
items.evidence: build-output.txt Scenario3_AppCapture.xaml.cs(37,30) WUI0004; migration-score.json feature 'Managing AppCapture' verdict=fail; lessons.json failed_apis[0].
items.root_cause: getforcurrentview section reads as an exhaustive 4-row table of view types; no general 'feature-service → HWND interop' rule.
items.change: Added a general note under the GetForCurrentView table: the table is not exhaustive; feature-service singletons (AppCapture, etc.) must be re-acquired via HWND-based COM interop (WindowNative.GetWindowHandle + window-scoped overload / As<IInitializeWithWindow>), with a code sketch. Tier-1 detection already exists (unsupported-api-inventory.json matches \bGetForCurrentView\s*\(); the missing piece was the replacement recipe, which is inherently prose.
items.expected_effect: Agent re-acquires per-view feature services via HWND interop instead of leaving GetForCurrentView() throwing.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, no WUI0004 on AppCapture.GetForCurrentView(); scenario 'Managing AppCapture' goes fail→pass (toggle present + live, status output rendered).

items.problem: The UWP-only call was silenced by a try/catch that only notified, shipping a dead feature while the build stayed green.
items.evidence: Scenario3_AppCapture.xaml.cs:35-44 (try/catch around AppCapture.GetForCurrentView() with catch calling NotifyUser).
items.root_cause: No explicit prohibition against swallowing UWP-only runtime failures.
items.change: Added an anti-pattern note to the WUI-analyzer-warnings section: never wrap a UWP-only API in a try/catch that only logs/notifies; fix the API instead. Broadened the WUI0004 row to read as any-type, not SystemNavigationManager-only.
items.expected_effect: Agent replaces unsupported APIs instead of suppressing their exceptions, eliminating silently-dead features.
items.falsifiable_check: On re-run, no UWP-only call appears inside a notifying try/catch; features backed by unsupported APIs are either fixed or plainly surfaced as unsupported, not dead.
